Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in BC, etc.—you’ll have to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑weekend span (including the holiday) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------------------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | Observed on Monday Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Ontario)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Third Monday in February |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Friday only |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | May 20 – May 22 | Monday before May 25 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Observed on Monday Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | First Monday in September |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Second Monday in October |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 11 – Nov 13 | Observed on Monday Nov 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Monday only |

### Quick‑look summary

| Long‑weekend | Holiday | Dates |
|--------------|---------|-------|
| Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 |
| Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Family Day | Feb 20 |
| Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Good Friday | Apr 7 |
| May 20 – May 22 | Victoria Day | May 22 |
| Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Canada Day | Jul 1 |
| Sep 2 – Sep 4 | Labour Day | Sep 4 |
| Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 |
| Nov 11 – Nov 13 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 |
| Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Dec 25 |

> **Tip for your app** – If you’re building a holiday‑planning feature, consider storing the holiday dates in a database and flagging those that fall on a Friday or Monday (or that are observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend). That way you can automatically generate the long‑weekend ranges for any year.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific long weekends or any other details!
